text_version.version: Original as issued by notice 京发改规〔2023〕10号 (Jing Fagai Gui [2023] No. 10), dated 2023-07-03; portal status 现行有效 [currently valid] at retrieval
text_version.note: Portal metadata block (subject, issuer, implementation date, document date, document number, publication date, validity), the issuing notice with its signature block, and all 15 articles of 《关于进一步加强数据中心项目节能审查的若干规定》. Website navigation and footer removed. The articles have no numbered items; provision IDs are 'Art. N' and 'para. P' for the separate paragraphs of Arts. 5 and 6. Art. 15 calls the instrument 本办法 [these Measures] although elsewhere it is 本规定 [these Provisions].

summary.short: Beijing DRC normative document, in force 4 August 2023, setting energy-review conditions for new and expanded data-centre projects in Beijing using at least 1,000 tce or 5 million kWh a year: PUE caps of 1.3 to 1.15 by energy-use band, storage and renewable-energy rules, monitoring, and differential electricity prices for data centres above PUE 1.4.
summary.long: The Provisions apply to new, expanded or renovated data-centre projects in Beijing with annual energy use of at least 1,000 tonnes of standard coal equivalent or annual electricity use of at least 5 million kWh, including projects whose racks and cooling reach those levels. Data centres must mainly serve the capital's 'four centres' functions and mainly provide computing; storage racks may not exceed 20% of total rack power. Energy reports must contain a renewable-energy plan; projects completed from 2021 are encouraged to raise the renewable share by 10% a year to 100% by 2030, verified annually by a third party commissioned by the energy-review authority. PUE may not exceed 1.3, 1.25, 1.2 or 1.15 depending on annual energy use. Further duties cover natural cooling, waste-heat use, grade-1 efficiency equipment, a ban on new equipment using ozone-depleting substances, reclaimed water, energy and water management systems, and online energy monitoring for projects of 5,000 tce or more. Half the rack power of a developer's closed Beijing data centres can be deducted from a new project's energy use. Projects below 80% rack loading two years after approval must apply for a change. Liability follows the national energy-review measures, with publication of results and credit-system records. Data centres operating above PUE 1.4 pay a surcharge of CNY 0.2 or 0.5 per kWh. The 2021 provisions are repealed.

territorial_scope.description: New, expanded or renovated data-centre projects within the Beijing municipal area (Art. 2).

evidence.quote: 本市范围内新建或改扩建的年能源消费量达到1000吨标准煤 [projects newly built, expanded or renovated within this municipality with annual energy consumption reaching 1,000 tce]

events.applies_to: Date of the Beijing DRC notice issuing the Provisions (also the portal's 成文日期 [document date])

evidence.quote: 北京市发展和改革委员会 2023年7月3日 [Beijing Municipal Commission of Development and Reform, 3 July 2023]

events.applies_to: Posting on fgw.beijing.gov.cn (portal metadata, not part of the notice)

external_evidence.description: Official Beijing DRC page for 京发改规〔2023〕10号; metadata field 发布日期 [publication date] 2023-07-05.

events.applies_to: All articles; the 2021 provisions (京发改规〔2021〕4号) are repealed on the same date

evidence.quote: 本办法自2023年8月4日起施行。原《关于进一步加强数据中心项目节能审查的若干规定》（京发改规〔2021〕4号）同时废止。 [These Measures take effect on 4 August 2023; the former Provisions (Jing Fagai Gui 2021 No. 4) are repealed at the same time.]

events.date_text: 于6月底前对项目上一年度可再生能源利用水平进行核实
events.applies_to: Annual third-party verification, commissioned by the energy-review authority, of each project's renewable-energy use in the previous year: by the end of June each year

evidence.quote: 委托第三方机构依据节能审查意见和节能报告于6月底前对项目上一年度可再生能源利用水平进行核实 [commission a third party to verify, by the end of June, the project's renewable-energy use in the previous year]

events.applies_to: Encouraged (鼓励) target for projects completed in 2021 or later: renewable share of annual energy use rising 10% a year to 100% by 2030, excluding the grid's existing renewable share

evidence.quote: 鼓励2021年及以后建成的项目，年可再生能源利用量占年能源消费量的比例按照每年10%递增，到2030年实现100%（不含电网既有可再生能源占比） [projects completed in 2021 or later are encouraged to raise the renewable share by 10% a year, reaching 100% by 2030, excluding the grid's existing renewable share]

events.date_text: 同时设计、同时施工、同时投产使用
events.anchor: Design, construction and commissioning of the data centre
events.applies_to: Online energy-consumption monitoring system (projects of 5,000 tce or more a year) must be designed, built and put into use at the same time as the data centre

evidence.quote: 能耗在线监测系统应当与数据中心同时设计、同时施工、同时投产使用 [the online energy-consumption monitoring system shall be designed, built and put into use at the same time as the data centre]

events.date_text: 取得节能审查意见后两年内
events.anchor: Date the project obtains its energy-review opinion (节能审查意见)
events.applies_to: Rack loading test: if rack loading has not reached 80% within two years of the energy-review opinion, the developer must apply to the original review authority for a change

evidence.quote: 项目取得节能审查意见后，两年内上架率 [within two years after the project obtains the energy-review opinion, the rack loading rate]

events.date_text: 已取得节能审查意见后两年内未开工建设
events.anchor: Date an earlier data-centre project of the developer obtained its energy-review opinion
events.applies_to: Construction-start test: the developer, its legal representative and shareholders must have no Beijing data-centre project that failed to start construction within two years of its energy-review opinion

evidence.quote: 在本市没有已取得节能审查意见后两年内未开工建设的数据中心项目 [have no data-centre project in this municipality that has not started construction within two years after obtaining the energy-review opinion]

thresholds.value_text: 年能源消费量达到1000吨标准煤（含，电力按当量值计算）
thresholds.unit: tonnes of standard coal equivalent (tce) per year
thresholds.measurement: Annual energy consumption of the project; electricity converted at calorific equivalent value (当量值); threshold inclusive
thresholds.consequence: New, expanded or renovated data-centre project falls under the Provisions
thresholds.conditions: Alternative to the 5 million kWh electricity test; projects with racks whose racks and cooling reach either level are treated as data-centre projects

evidence.quote: 年能源消费量达到1000吨标准煤（含，电力按当量值计算） [annual energy consumption reaching 1,000 tce (inclusive; electricity at calorific equivalent value)]

thresholds.value_text: 年电力消费量达到500万千瓦时（含）以上
thresholds.measurement: Annual electricity consumption of the project; threshold inclusive
thresholds.consequence: New, expanded or renovated data-centre project falls under the Provisions
thresholds.conditions: Alternative to the 1,000 tce energy test

evidence.quote: 年电力消费量达到500万千瓦时（含）以上的数据中心项目，适用本规定 [data-centre projects with annual electricity consumption of 5 million kWh (inclusive) or more are subject to these Provisions]

thresholds.variable_text: 用于数据存储功能的机柜功率比例
thresholds.measurement: Power of racks used for data storage as a share of total rack power, per the project's functional plan and configuration statement
thresholds.consequence: Storage racks may not exceed 20% of total rack power in a new or expanded data centre

evidence.quote: 应当保证用于数据存储功能的机柜功率比例不高于机柜总功率的20% [shall ensure that racks used for data storage do not exceed 20% of total rack power]

thresholds.variable_text: 年可再生能源利用量占年能源消费量的比例
thresholds.unit: percent increase per year in the renewable share of annual energy consumption
thresholds.measurement: Annual renewable-energy use as a share of annual energy consumption, excluding the grid's existing renewable share; verified yearly by a third party (Art. 5 para. 3)
thresholds.consequence: Encouraged annual increase in the renewable share for projects completed in 2021 or later

evidence.quote: 年可再生能源利用量占年能源消费量的比例按照每年10%递增 [renewable share of annual energy consumption increasing by 10% a year]

thresholds.variable_text: 年可再生能源利用量占年能源消费量的比例
thresholds.value_text: 到2030年实现100%（不含电网既有可再生能源占比）
thresholds.measurement: Excludes the grid's existing renewable share
thresholds.consequence: Encouraged renewable share of 100% by 2030 for projects completed in 2021 or later

evidence.quote: 到2030年实现100%（不含电网既有可再生能源占比） [100% by 2030 (excluding the grid's existing renewable share)]

thresholds.variable_text: 所关闭的数据中心机柜总功率（不含强制退出关闭的部分）的一半
thresholds.unit: percent of the total rack power of the closed data centres
thresholds.measurement: Total rack power of the developer's or its shareholders' closed, operating Beijing data centres, excluding capacity closed by forced exit; closure verified by a third party
thresholds.consequence: Half of the closed rack power is deducted when calculating the energy use of the new or expanded project
thresholds.conditions: Closure of all (or controlled) other operating data centres in Beijing at the same time as building or expanding the new one; proof of closure submitted

evidence.quote: 所关闭的数据中心机柜总功率（不含强制退出关闭的部分）的一半可以在计算新建、扩建项目能耗时予以扣减 [half of the total rack power of the closed data centres (excluding forced closures) may be deducted when calculating the new or expanded project's energy consumption]

thresholds.value_text: 年能源消费量小于1万吨标准煤（电力按等价值计算，下同）
thresholds.measurement: Annual energy consumption of the project; electricity converted at equal value (等价值), unlike the calorific-equivalent conversion in Art. 2

evidence.quote: 年能源消费量小于1万吨标准煤（电力按等价值计算，下同）的项目PUE值不应高于1.3 [projects with annual energy use below 10,000 tce (electricity at equal value) shall have a PUE no higher than 1.3]

thresholds.unit: PUE (ratio; not defined in the text)
thresholds.measurement: Not stated in Art. 7; measurement method not specified
thresholds.consequence: Maximum PUE for new or expanded data centres using less than 10,000 tce a year

evidence.quote: 的项目PUE值不应高于1.3 [projects' PUE shall not exceed 1.3]

thresholds.value_text: 年能源消费量大于等于1万吨标准煤且小于2万吨标准煤
thresholds.measurement: Annual energy consumption (electricity at equal value); lower bound inclusive, upper bound exclusive

evidence.quote: 年能源消费量大于等于1万吨标准煤且小于2万吨标准煤的项目，PUE值不应高于1.25 [projects using at least 10,000 and less than 20,000 tce a year: PUE no higher than 1.25]

thresholds.unit: PUE (ratio; not defined in the text)
thresholds.measurement: Measurement method not specified in Art. 7
thresholds.consequence: Maximum PUE for new or expanded data centres using 10,000 to under 20,000 tce a year
thresholds.conditions: Annual energy consumption at least 10,000 and below 20,000 tce

evidence.quote: 小于2万吨标准煤的项目，PUE值不应高于1.25 [projects below 20,000 tce: PUE no higher than 1.25]

thresholds.value_text: 年能源消费量大于等于2万吨标准煤且小于3万吨标准煤
thresholds.measurement: Annual energy consumption (electricity at equal value); lower bound inclusive, upper bound exclusive

evidence.quote: 年能源消费量大于等于2万吨标准煤且小于3万吨标准煤的项目，PUE值不应高于1.2 [projects using at least 20,000 and less than 30,000 tce a year: PUE no higher than 1.2]

thresholds.unit: PUE (ratio; not defined in the text)
thresholds.measurement: Measurement method not specified in Art. 7
thresholds.consequence: Maximum PUE for new or expanded data centres using 20,000 to under 30,000 tce a year
thresholds.conditions: Annual energy consumption at least 20,000 and below 30,000 tce

evidence.quote: 小于3万吨标准煤的项目，PUE值不应高于1.2 [projects below 30,000 tce: PUE no higher than 1.2]

thresholds.value_text: 年能源消费量大于等于3万吨标准煤
thresholds.measurement: Annual energy consumption (electricity at equal value); inclusive

evidence.quote: 年能源消费量大于等于3万吨标准煤的项目，PUE值不应高于1.15 [projects using 30,000 tce or more a year: PUE no higher than 1.15]

thresholds.unit: PUE (ratio; not defined in the text)
thresholds.measurement: Measurement method not specified in Art. 7
thresholds.consequence: Maximum PUE for new or expanded data centres using 30,000 tce or more a year
thresholds.conditions: Annual energy consumption of 30,000 tce or more

evidence.quote: 大于等于3万吨标准煤的项目，PUE值不应高于1.15 [projects of 30,000 tce or more: PUE no higher than 1.15]

thresholds.value_text: 年能源消费量达到5000吨标准煤及以上
thresholds.measurement: Annual energy consumption of the project; inclusive
thresholds.consequence: Project must build an online energy-consumption monitoring system measuring PUE and connected to the Beijing energy-saving monitoring service platform; projects below 5,000 tce are only encouraged to do so

evidence.quote: 年能源消费量达到5000吨标准煤及以上的项目，应当建设能耗在线监测系统 [projects with annual energy consumption of 5,000 tce or more shall build an online energy-consumption monitoring system]

thresholds.variable_text: 上架率（实际上架的机柜额定总功率/项目机柜设计额定总功率）
thresholds.unit: percent (rated power of racks actually installed / designed rated rack power)
thresholds.measurement: Rack loading rate within two years after the energy-review opinion
thresholds.consequence: Developer must apply to the original energy-review authority for a change
thresholds.conditions: Two years have passed since the energy-review opinion

evidence.quote: 两年内上架率（实际上架的机柜额定总功率/项目机柜设计额定总功率）未达到80%的，建设单位应当向原节能审查机关提出变更申请 [if rack loading (installed rated rack power / designed rated rack power) has not reached 80% within two years, the developer shall apply to the original energy-review authority for a change]

thresholds.measurement: Actual operating PUE checked in energy inspections organised by the municipal energy-review authority against the DB11/T1139 energy-efficiency limit standard
thresholds.consequence: Data centre is placed on the list of units paying differential electricity prices; Beijing Electric Power Company is notified to collect the surcharge

evidence.quote: 对于超过标准限定值（PUE值1.4）的数据中心，将按本市差别电价有关规定中超过单位产品能耗限额的情形，确定执行差别电价单位的名单 [data centres above the standard limit (PUE 1.4) are listed as units subject to differential electricity prices under the municipal rules for exceeding unit-product energy-consumption limits]

thresholds.value_text: PUE>1.4且≤1.8的项目（单位电耗超过限额标准一倍以内）
thresholds.measurement: Lower bound exclusive (>1.4), upper bound inclusive (≤1.8); described as unit electricity use exceeding the limit standard by up to one times
thresholds.consequence: Electricity surcharge of CNY 0.2 per kWh

evidence.quote: 对于PUE>1.4且≤1.8的项目（单位电耗超过限额标准一倍以内），执行的电价加价标准为每度电加价0.2元 [for projects with PUE above 1.4 and up to 1.8 (unit electricity use exceeding the limit by up to one times), the surcharge is CNY 0.2 per kWh]

thresholds.value_text: PUE>1.8的项目（单位电耗超过限额标准一倍以上）
thresholds.measurement: Described as unit electricity use exceeding the limit standard by more than one times
thresholds.consequence: Electricity surcharge of CNY 0.5 per kWh

evidence.quote: 对于PUE>1.8的项目（单位电耗超过限额标准一倍以上），每度电加价0.5元 [for projects with PUE above 1.8 (unit electricity use exceeding the limit by more than one times), CNY 0.5 per kWh]

obligations.summary: New or expanded data centres must mainly support the capital's 'four centres' and 'four services' functions; the developer must provide a clear business-demand list or related letters of intent matching that positioning.
obligations.conditional_on: Energy review of a new, expanded or renovated data-centre project in scope (Art. 2)

evidence.quote: 新建或改扩建数据中心应当主要用于支撑“四个中心”建设 [new or expanded data centres shall mainly support the 'four centres'] ... 建设单位应当提供符合功能定位的明确的业务需求清单或相关意向协议 [the developer shall provide a clear business-demand list or related letters of intent consistent with the functional positioning]

obligations.summary: New or expanded data centres must be mainly computing-type: the developer submits a functional plan and configuration statement for computing and storage, and storage racks may not exceed 20% of total rack power.

evidence.quote: 新建或改扩建数据中心应当主要为计算型。建设单位应当提供项目运行后用于数据计算、存储等方面的功能规划说明及配置说明 [new or expanded data centres shall mainly be computing-type; the developer shall provide a functional plan and configuration statement for computing, storage, etc.]

obligations.summary: The project's energy report must include a renewable-energy utilisation plan, and new or expanded data centres must progressively raise their renewable share.

evidence.quote: 项目节能报告中应当包括可再生能源利用方案。新建及改扩建数据中心应当逐步提高可再生能源利用比例 [the energy report shall include a renewable-energy plan; new and expanded data centres shall progressively raise the renewable share]

obligations.summary: Projects completed in 2021 or later are encouraged to raise the renewable share of annual energy use by 10% a year to 100% by 2030, excluding the grid's existing renewable share.

evidence.quote: 鼓励2021年及以后建成的项目，年可再生能源利用量占年能源消费量的比例按照每年10%递增 [projects completed in 2021 or later are encouraged to raise the renewable share by 10% a year]

obligations.summary: Developers are encouraged to build their own distributed renewable facilities; they may install PV on roofs (and outer walls where feasible) and may cover remaining demand through green-power trading, green electricity certificates or purchased energy savings.

evidence.quote: 鼓励建设单位通过自建分布式可再生能源设施提高新能源和可再生能源利用水平 [developers are encouraged to build their own distributed renewable facilities] ... 可以通过绿色电力交易或认购可再生能源绿色电力证书、购买节能量等方式提高可再生能源利用比例 [may raise the renewable share through green-power trading, green electricity certificates or purchasing energy savings]

obligations.summary: The energy-review authorities commission a third party to verify, by the end of June each year, each project's renewable-energy use in the previous year against the energy-review opinion and energy report.

evidence.quote: 节能审查机关（即市发展改革部门，各区发展改革委、北京经济技术开发区经济发展局和行政审批局）委托第三方机构依据节能审查意见和节能报告于6月底前对项目上一年度可再生能源利用水平进行核实 [the energy-review authorities commission a third party to verify the previous year's renewable use by the end of June]

obligations.summary: The developer must cooperate with the annual verification of renewable-energy use.

evidence.quote: 项目建设单位应对核实工作予以配合。 [the project developer shall cooperate with the verification]

obligations.summary: A developer or its shareholders that close all their (or controlled) other operating data centres in Beijing while building or expanding a data centre may deduct half the closed rack power (excluding forced closures) from the new project's energy use, on submission of proof of closure.
obligations.conditional_on: Closure of the other data centres at the same time as the new build or expansion; proof submitted

evidence.quote: 建设单位或其股东在新建、扩建数据中心同时关闭其所有（或控股的）的位于本市行政区域内已投运的其他数据中心的 [where the developer or its shareholders, while building or expanding a data centre, close all their (or controlled) other operating data centres in this municipality] ... 关闭存量数据中心应当提交相应证明 [closure of existing data centres shall be supported by proof]

obligations.summary: The department managing energy-conservation work commissions a third party to verify closures of existing data centres claimed for the Art. 6 deduction.

evidence.quote: 管理节能工作的部门委托第三方机构对数据中心关闭情况进行核实 [the department managing energy conservation commissions a third party to verify the closures]

obligations.summary: New or expanded data centres must not exceed a PUE of 1.3 (under 10,000 tce a year), 1.25 (10,000 to under 20,000 tce), 1.2 (20,000 to under 30,000 tce) or 1.15 (30,000 tce or more).

evidence.quote: 新建、扩建数据中心，年能源消费量小于1万吨标准煤（电力按等价值计算，下同）的项目PUE值不应高于1.3 [new or expanded data centres below 10,000 tce a year: PUE no higher than 1.3] ... 年能源消费量大于等于3万吨标准煤的项目，PUE值不应高于1.15 [30,000 tce or more: PUE no higher than 1.15]

obligations.summary: Data centres must make full use of natural cooling and strengthen waste-heat use through own use or external heat supply.

evidence.quote: 数据中心应当充分利用自然冷源，通过自用、对外供热等方式加强余热资源利用 [data centres shall make full use of natural cooling and strengthen waste-heat use through own use or external heat supply]

obligations.summary: General energy-using equipment (cooling, ventilation, transformers, etc.) must meet or exceed grade-1 energy-efficiency standards.

evidence.quote: 制冷设备、通风设备、变压器等通用用能设备的能效水平应当达到或超过一级能效标准 [cooling, ventilation, transformers and other general equipment shall meet or exceed grade-1 energy efficiency]

obligations.summary: No new equipment or facilities using ozone-depleting substances (per the MEE list of controlled ozone-depleting substances) as working fluid.

evidence.quote: 禁止新增以消耗臭氧层物质为工质（以生态环境部《中国受控消耗臭氧层物质清单》为准）的设备设施 [new equipment using ozone-depleting substances as working fluid is prohibited]

obligations.summary: Data centres are encouraged to couple waste heat with nearby heat sources, use products in the MIIT catalogue of advanced green data-centre technologies, use refrigeration with natural working fluids such as CO2, and adopt efficient water-saving systems.

evidence.quote: 鼓励数据中心余热与周边既有热源耦合利用。鼓励采用工信部《绿色数据中心先进适用技术产品目录》中的技术产品 [encouraged: coupling waste heat with nearby heat sources; using products in the MIIT green data-centre catalogue] ... 鼓励采用以二氧化碳等自然工质为介质的制冷设备。鼓励数据中心采用高效节水系统。

obligations.summary: Data centres must make full use of reclaimed water; within the reclaimed-water network's coverage, non-domestic water (equipment and air-conditioning cooling water, machine-room humidification) should in principle be reclaimed water.

evidence.quote: 数据中心项目应充分利用再生水。再生水输配管网覆盖范围内的数据中心，设备冷却水、空调冷却水、机房加湿等非生活用水原则上应采用再生水。 [data-centre projects shall make full use of reclaimed water; within network coverage, non-domestic water shall in principle be reclaimed water]

obligations.summary: Developers of new or expanded projects must establish an energy management system and a water-saving management system following GB/T 23331, DB11/T 1768 and related standards.

evidence.quote: 新建、扩建项目建设单位应当按照《能源管理体系要求》（GB/T23331）、《建筑水表配置规范》（DB11/T 1768）等相关标准要求，建立健全能源管理体系以及节水管理体系 [developers shall establish energy and water-saving management systems per GB/T23331, DB11/T 1768 and related standards]

obligations.summary: Projects using 5,000 tce or more a year must build an online energy-consumption monitoring system that measures PUE, connects to the Beijing energy-saving monitoring service platform, is designed, built and commissioned with the data centre, and transmits continuous, complete and true data.
obligations.conditional_on: Annual energy consumption of 5,000 tce or more

evidence.quote: 应当建设能耗在线监测系统，按照相关标准要求实现PUE值测量，并接入北京市节能监测服务平台 [shall build an online monitoring system, measure PUE per the relevant standards and connect to the Beijing energy-saving monitoring service platform] ... 数据中心应当确保能耗在线监测系统运行安全、稳定，数据传输连续、完整、真实。

obligations.summary: Projects using less than 5,000 tce a year are encouraged to build an online energy-consumption monitoring system connected to the Beijing energy-saving monitoring service platform.

notes: Scope: Arts. 2-12 govern energy review of new, expanded or renovated projects; Art. 14 inspects the 'actual operating PUE' of data centres (数据中心实际运行PUE值) without limiting it to projects reviewed under these Provisions, so whether existing data centres are covered by the surcharge is not stated. PUE caps differ only by annual energy-use band (Art. 7); the text has no location-based PUE differentiation. Electricity is converted at calorific equivalent value (当量值) for the scope test (Art. 2) and at equal value (等价值) for the PUE bands (Art. 7). PUE is not defined; Art. 10 refers to measurement 'per relevant standards'. The renewable trajectory (10% a year, 100% by 2030) is encouraged (鼓励), not mandatory; the mandatory part is the renewable plan and a progressive increase (Art. 5 para. 1). The differential electricity price (Art. 14) is coded both as pricing-tier thresholds and as an enforcement row; the surcharge amount is per kWh, not a maximum fine. Art. 6 refers to the 'department managing energy-conservation work' (管理节能工作的部门) without naming it. No private right of action is created or excluded. The text gives no agency-meeting adoption date; the registry's adopted date (2023-07-03) is the notice date, coded here as 'signed'. Art. 15 calls the instrument 本办法 [these Measures].
